context.stage: F8 — Tenant Management GUI (Batch 1: TM-01, TM-02, TM-03)

task.description:
Hard gate: validate the CODE-DESIGNER artefacts for TM-01, TM-02, TM-03 before BACKEND-DEV and FRONTEND-DEV begin implementation.

Check:
1. templates/specs/tenant-list.list-page.yaml (Type B) — run codegen --dry-run; verify it covers TM-01 acceptance criteria (all 5 fields, PLATFORM_ADMIN gate, paginated, row-level Edit action)
2. src/design/tenant-management.md (Type E) — verify: no implementation code, all public function signatures listed, PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug fully specified, error taxonomy exists, Keycloak propagation path documented, immutability contract present
3. TM-02 — documented as navigation link (no new artefact) — acceptable per design
4. No contradictions with existing RELEASED requirements
5. Design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV and FRONTEND-DEV to proceed without ambiguity

Return PASS or FAIL. On FAIL: list specific issues with severity. BACKEND-DEV MUST NOT start until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: TM-01 ACs all traceable in the Type B spec
TM-03 ACs all traceable in src/design/tenant-management.md
No implementation code in either artefact
Error taxonomy covers TenantNotFound, ImmutableFieldUpdate, KeycloakSyncFailed

result.summary: Design artefacts for tenant management (TM-01, TM-02, TM-03) validated. codegen --dry-run exits 0. No BLOCKER/MAJOR lint issues on either artefact. All 5 TM-01 fields present in Type B spec. PLATFORM_ADMIN gate and row Edit action present. TM-02 documented as navigation link. TM-03 ACs fully traceable: PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug specified, error taxonomy complete with HTTP codes, Keycloak propagation path documented (updateClient + updateRealmFrontendUrl steps), immutability contract present, all public function signatures listed.

issues.description: lint_design_artefact.py reports 14 E060 false positives on tenant-management.md. The linter mis-tokenises words from the Section 5 prose sentence as requirement IDs. No actual requirement IDs are malformed; these are false positives from inline natural-language text.

YAML comment on list_query_key suggests a no-param factory tenants: () => [...queryKeys.admin.all, "tenants"] as const, but the generated code calls queryKeys.admin.tenants({ search }). FRONTEND-DEV must implement the factory accepting an optional params object: tenants: (params?: { search?: string }) => [...queryKeys.admin.all, "tenants", params] as const.

Section 6 of tenant-management.md contains a 2-line illustrative RBAC code snippet (existing pattern from identity.zig). It is a documentation example, not a new function body. Acceptable as a pattern reference; BACKEND-DEV should not treat it as a complete implementation.
